proposals.title: 經典雙窗
proposals.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: design proposal for a classic Lineage idle RPG's TWO SEPARATE floating windows.
Input images: Image 1 is a sanitized capture of the actual existing two-window interaction (functional content and window separation reference). Image 2 is the approved backpack frame (palette and aged material reference).
NON-NEGOTIABLE LAYOUT: exactly TWO completely INDEPENDENT floating windows, side by side with a clearly visible 24–40px empty gap. Each window has its own fully closed four-sided metal border, own title bar and own close X. The LEFT window is read-only "能力比較". The RIGHT window is "物品資訊" and contains ALL item actions. They must NEVER share an enclosing outer frame, connecting border, background surface, title bar or footer. The two windows can have different heights. Do not draw a third window, a surrounding app or a single combined dialog.
Style: elegant restrained late-1990s Lineage pixel-painted RPG interface. Both windows use identical weathered silver bevels, subtle bronze corner details, low-contrast olive-charcoal stone/leather, ivory text and muted gold headings. Preserve small original pixel-game helmet icons and class glyphs; no new hero illustration or characters. Controlled ornament, clean readable typography, good whitespace and precise alignment, no neon/glass/pills.
Exact synthetic example in all proposals: currently equipped "抗魔法頭盔", candidate "+7 抗魔法頭盔". Comparison: "防禦 AC", current "-9", after "-16", favorable change "-7" green; "魔防 MR", current "10", after "17", favorable change "+7" green. Show each delta only once; no duplicated parentheses. Candidate information: "防禦(AC): -2", "魔防(MR): +11", "重量: 35", "安定值: 4", "販賣價格: 1260 金幣", eight small class glyph icons after "適用職業". Labels in Traditional Chinese. Do not invent new stats, abilities or gameplay mechanics.
The LEFT window shows the currently equipped item's identity and the main character's actual before/after capability comparison; it has NO equip/sell/enhance controls, only its own close X. The RIGHT window has candidate identity with item lock icon, native item stats and description, distinct prominent "裝備", secondary "強化", checkbox "標記為廢品", quiet separated "販賣" and "全部賣出", plus "關閉視窗" and its own close X. All actions remain within the RIGHT window.
Presentation: one single landscape 1536x1024 polished mockup on a quiet dark neutral background. Both independent windows fit fully with margins, fronts orthographic, complete frame edges and controls visible. No chat, player names, inventory sidebar, other app UI, explanatory captions or decorative props. This is a concept for selection; use only the stated example content.

Design A — 經典雙窗. The most familiar layout: LEFT comparison window is about 600px wide and 690px high; RIGHT item-information window is about 640px wide and 900px high. Align their top edges while retaining a clear empty gap. Each has its own restrained silver winglet border and bronze square close button.
LEFT: title "能力比較", section "目前裝備中", original small helmet icon and "抗魔法頭盔", compact current item information including AC -2 / MR +4, weight35, safe4 and class icons. A distinct lower "換裝後變化" section has two clean rows, showing AC -9 → -16 with -7 at right, MR 10 → 17 with +7 at right. Read-only and calm.
RIGHT: candidate icon and name +7 抗魔法頭盔 below "物品資訊". Compact details and class glyphs above a thin separator. Below that, a primary warm-gold 裝備 button, a secondary 強化 button beside it, a clean checkbox row, and small utility 販賣 / 全部賣出 with a wide 關閉視窗 beneath. Keep the candidate screen balanced without massive tall button stacks. The overall material is exactly the approved frame family.

Design B — 精簡對照. Make the LEFT window short and broad (roughly 690px wide × 510px high) while the RIGHT item window is narrower and taller (roughly 550px × 900px). Align at the same top with clearly separate closed frames and a broad dark gap. The left must visibly end halfway down the right window, producing two different independent silhouettes.
LEFT title "能力比較". One compact current-item strip with tiny helmet icon and "目前：抗魔法頭盔". Below, the centerpiece is an exceptionally clear 4-column table: "能力" / "目前" / "裝備後" / "變化". AC row -9, -16, -7. MR row 10, 17, +7. A hairline separates a small "目前裝備說明 ▾" disclosure row at bottom. Nothing else. Keep full candidate native stats, class glyphs, weight, stability, sale price and readable description area. Use the same silver metal and olive-charcoal materials as design A, but slightly simpler engraved straight side rails with small original fantasy corner details. Do not merge or connect the two windows.

Design C — 窄幅比較. Visibly asymmetric TWO-window composition: LEFT is a narrow independent comparison window around 380px wide × 690px high; RIGHT is a more spacious independent information window around 810px wide × 850px high. Align top edges, show a clear unfilled dark gap. Each window has its own complete silver frame, separate title bar and close X. The narrow left frame should occupy roughly one third of the combined width, unlike A's equal-ish windows or B's broad comparison table.
LEFT title "能力比較". Stack one small original helmet sprite with the currently equipped name "抗魔法頭盔" and a compact "目前裝備" caption. Add two well-spaced recessed stat sections (not a four-column table): "防禦 AC" on its own label line, then "-9 → -16" with small green "-7"; next "魔防 MR", then "10 → 17" with green "+7". A modest "裝備說明 ▾" disclosure at bottom retains detailed current information. All text remains readable, no gameplay actions in this window.
RIGHT title "物品資訊". A horizontal candidate header with small original helmet icon, "+7 抗魔法頭盔", slot "頭盔" and the lock on the right. A clearly structured roomy native-information region with candidate defense/MR and class glyphs, then weight, safe enhancement and sale price in one neatly aligned details region. Use very subtle carved horizontal separators. Keep the bottom action zone firmly INSIDE THIS RIGHT WINDOW: native checkbox above, warm gold 裝備 button at bottom-right, secondary 強化 beside it, and quiet 販賣 / 全部賣出 / 關閉視窗 in a separate subordinate utility row.
